sources.title: Florian Louis, interview with Pierre Nora on reading, editing and collective history (2022).
sources.citation: Florian Louis, interview with Pierre Nora, Le Grand Continent, 1 December 2022; current heading “L’obstination d’une lecture intelligente, Pierre Nora (1931–2025)” includes a later memorial framing.

verification.note: Complete displayed original French interview read through the final answer, with original author/date and later memorial introduction distinguished. Actual successful web-tool rendering saved privately; ordinary network403 response is separately named and not used as body. Specific Ariès inspiration, Furet editorial assembly and Le Goff project expansion verified in own answers; later recollections of Foucault’s emotions or Hobsbawm’s politics are not independently established. No full memoir, cited book, private correspondence or all collective volumes read.

sources.title: Marie-Claire Lavabre, “Usages du passé, usages de la mémoire” (1994), selected opening.
sources.citation: Marie-Claire Lavabre, “Usages du passé, usages de la mémoire,” Revue française de science politique44(3),1994:480–493; opening480 only freshly read in Persée repository transcription.

verification.note: Original journal repository opening480 freshly read, including notes; later481–493 unread in this continuation. Lavabre identifies joint Le Goff/Nora1974publication and criticizes the memory moment’s neglect of older collective-memory discussions and concrete mechanisms, naming Bastide/Halbwachs/Yates. This selected criticism is not a fresh reading of all reviewed books or a claim that no memory scholarship investigated mechanisms. No full Lavabre node; held-only reception source.
